title: T-Mobile US, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-23
summary: T-Mobile US, Inc. filed an 8-K on April 23, 2026, announcing that its Board of Directors authorized an increase to the 2026 Shareholder Return Program from up to $14.6 billion to up to $18.2 billion (an additional $3.6 billion). The program includes share repurchases and cash dividends, with Q2 2026 dividend of $1.02 per share payable on June 11, 2026 to stockholders of record as of May 29, 2026.
key_points: Board authorized increase to 2026 Shareholder Return Program from $14.6 billion to $18.2 billion (additional $3.6 billion)
2026 Shareholder Return Program runs through December 31, 2026
Q2 2026 cash dividend of $1.02 per share announced, payable June 11, 2026 to stockholders of record May 29, 2026
Q1 2026 cash dividend of $1.02 per share was paid on March 12, 2026
Share repurchases may be made via open market purchases, 10b5-1 plans, accelerated share repurchases, or privately negotiated transactions
Repurchases and dividends funded from available cash on hand and proceeds from debt issuances or borrowings
why_it_matters: This filing represents standard corporate capital return activity for T-Mobile. It is relevant to TMUS shareholders and investors evaluating the company's capital allocation strategy, but does not constitute a macro catalyst or market structure event.
